title: Dark mode
prompt: dark mode for the whole page, including the side boxes and tables, with text that's easy to read
author: Morse team
note: Hand-fixed: the model made the text dark on anything with "bg-neutral-800" in its classes, which on this site includes the light buttons and badges (their dark-mode class names), so they were unreadable. That rule is gone, and two lines give the light version badges dark backgrounds.
